name: When is the best time to buy a pre-construction condo?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to buy a pre-construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to buy a pre-construction condo is often during the early launch phases when prices may be lower and more customization options are available. However, a practical tradeoff is the longer waiting period for completion and increased uncertainty. Securing a unit early in a high-demand area like Sunny Isles Beach or Brickell can offer greater appreciation potential by completion, but requires patience.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to buy pre-construction is often during early launch for lower prices and more customization, despite a longer wait.
